missingObservation: Original API35 initial channel hierarchy was overwritten when UI returned to the fixture. No claim that actual API35 collapsing_toolbar own attributes were empty, or that new fallback has passed on an Android35 device.
change: Only if the sole exact Settings collapsing_toolbar has both own text and own content-desc empty, inspect its sole direct exact action_bar child. Require Settings package, class android.widget.Toolbar or android.view.ViewGroup, and exactly one nonempty direct android.widget.TextView title, Settings package, exact text and no conflicting description. Child content-desc alone never establishes a title. Any existing container own title remains authoritative; it cannot be overridden by a child.

verification.newTestScope: Synthetic title-child representation derived from pinned AOSP Android15 layout/code and actual Android36 accessibility class. Two positive class cases, each one tap despite repeated stale tree and no premature verification/ack. Fifteen negative cases: wrong toolbar id/package/class, nested or duplicate toolbar, wrong title package/class/text, description-only, nested/outside/duplicate title, conflicting description, nonempty wrong own title, duplicate collapsing container. These are host synthetic cases, not captured Android35 UI.

limits: No change to switches, ack, APK/package verification or API24 rules; no Flutter/Go/device/AVD operations. Official upstream Material1.11.0 setTitle/content-description behavior was inspected as supplemental context but is not asserted as the pinned AOSP35 compiled dependency and is not needed for this fallback.
